The '''2024 Retro League''' was the third season of the [[Retro League]] on [[GEMP]], with a flat \$10 entry fee. It added the first [[Retro Online Championship Series]] (ROCS) as a year-end playoff.<ref name="t84002" /> [[Steve Sanders]] was the tournament director.<ref name="t84002" />

== Changes ==
* Premiere - Cloud City joined, with a ban list: ''Never Tell Me The Odds'', ''Asteroid Sanctuary'', ''Clouds'' (Light), ''Anger, Fear, Aggression'', ''3,720 To 1'', ''A Dangerous Time'' and ''Defensive Fire''.<ref name="t84002" />
* Premiere - Endor allowed ECC and EJP cards.<ref name="t84002" />
* Cumulative scoring was published: 3 points per win, 1 per loss, and +4 and +2 bonus points for first and second in an event.<ref name="t84316" />

== ROCS ==
:''Main article: [[2024 Retro Online Championship Series Playoffs]]''
The first ROCS ran 1–21 December for the top eight in the cumulative standings.<ref name="t84770" /> [[Brad Kippel]] beat [[Paul Todd Feldman]] in the final, making Kippel the 2024 champion.<ref name="pcrocs24" />

Seeds: 1. [[Paul Todd Feldman]], 2. [[Joe Horbey]], 3. [[Brad Kippel]], 4. [[Timo Dusel]], 5. [[Eddie Szwabowski]], 6. [[Matt Fendt]], 7. [[Charles Hickey|Charlie Hickey]], 8. [[Tony Petersson]].<ref name="t84770" />
